# Anypod

> Private, ad-free, open-source podcast player and RSS client.

Anypod is a modern web podcast client and progressive web app (PWA) designed with complete privacy:
- No tracking, no user profiles, no advertisements.
- Direct RSS podcast subscription without central server accounts.
- YouTube audio streaming and channel feeds.
- Built-in AI Taste profile running privately on-device.
- Offline-ready Progressive Web App (PWA) via service worker and IndexedDB.
- Optional client-side encrypted cloud sync.
- User data automatically expires and deletes after 50 days of inactivity.

## Features

- Direct RSS feed subscription and XML/JSON parsing.
- YouTube channel, playlist, and video audio streaming.
- Local playback progress tracking with resume.
- Queue management, favorites, download manager, speed controls (0.5x - 3.0x).
- Curated directory of science, space, nature, and technology shows.
- Audio normalization via Web Audio DynamicsCompressor (Voice Boost).
- Client-side ID3v2 binary chapter parsing and Podcast 2.0 chapters.
- `<itunes:block>` and `<podcast:locked>` channel privacy guards.

## Links

- [Anypod Web App](https://anypod.org/): Private web podcast player and RSS client.
- [DJ Studio](https://dj.anypod.org/): Dual-deck Web Audio DJ mixing console.
- [Workout Sets](https://sets.anypod.org/): Interval training audio sequencer.
- [Source Code](https://github.com/orangedot/anypod): Open-source MIT repository on GitHub.
- [Self-Hosting Guide](https://github.com/orangedot/anypod/blob/main/app/SELF_HOSTING.md): Deployment instructions for Cloudflare Pages and Docker.
- [Feed Proxy API](https://anypod.org/api/feed): CORS-compliant RSS podcast feed proxy and parser.
